title: 第2360章 半祖的领域世界第2359章 进入光罩之门
content_zh:
光罩之门，内部空间中。
成功跨越光罩之门，牧帆和冥夜无天，便都走出了大秦玉玺。
牧帆和冥夜无天，皆是警惕的观望着四周，打量着周围的环境。
周围的环境，与在黑域平原内相比，已经彻底变了。
在黑域平原内，黑雾笼罩整个天地，地表荒凉无比，几乎看不到什么生机，神识什么的，全部都大大受限，任何人进入其中，都仿佛被蒙住了双眼。
而这里却不一样，有各种花草树木，生机盎然，仿佛来到了一片原始森林，神识什么的，也并没有受阻，没有任何限制。
冥夜无天的神识释放了出去，并没有什么异样，却发现根本勘察不到边缘，也就说明这里相当的广阔，他顿时疑惑了，“这里是什么地方，看起来非常的广袤，没想到黑域平原的内部，竟还有这样的地方……”
牧帆当然也不知道这里是什么地方，随即传音询问道：“剑灵，你觉得这是什么地方？”
剑灵传音道：“谁知道这里是什么地方，不过，传闻大秦宝藏，就藏在大秦始帝的墓穴当中，既然玉玺指引你来到这里，说不定这里就有大秦始帝的墓穴呢！”
牧帆闻言，低头看了看手中的玉玺，此时的玉玺，仍然还在指引，在不停的晃动。
冥夜无天见状，开口道：“牧帆兄，我们都已经一同来到这里了，是不是该告诉我这里是什么地方了？”
牧帆想了想，开口道：“关于中古时期的大秦神朝，以及大秦宝藏，想必你应该也有所耳闻吧？”
冥夜无天目光顿时一凛，“大秦宝藏听说只是一个传闻而已，自然是听说过。”
牧帆看着手中的玉玺，解释道：“帝神天域内，有一世界，名为秦王界，在秦王界中有一秦家，听说这个秦家和中古时期的大秦神朝有着千丝万缕的关系，也因此导致秦家一直被无数人盯着，无数势力的人都试图撬开秦家的秘密。”
“终于，战斗爆发了，秦家被灭了门，唯有秦家家主的儿子，带着一块玉玺成功逃离，于是便有了猜测，这玉玺肯定很不一般，或许和大秦宝藏有关！”
冥夜无天看着牧帆手中的玉玺，问道：“所以这块玉玺，便是从那秦家家主的儿子身上得来的？”
“正是！”
牧帆点头，“之前，我在玄元天域内的时候，黑域平原上空突然出现异象，恰好从这个时候开始，这块大秦玉玺便仿佛受到了指引，不停的晃动，在指引一个方向前进，从那个时候起，我便有了判断，这黑域平原内的异象，或许和大秦宝藏有关。”
冥夜无天道：“原来是有这个东西指引你，难怪你在黑域平原内的时候，明显目标明确，丝毫不耽搁，仿佛熟悉这里一样。”
牧帆苦笑道：“我不过第二次来到黑域平原而已，怎么可能熟悉这里？几乎可以说是完全不了解，只不过我一路上都有这个玉玺指引着前行，所以没有耽搁而已。”

冥夜无天双手环胸，“也难怪，刚才一直无法进入这里，有了这个玉玺之后，会变得那么顺利。”
这么一看的话，此处或许可能真的埋藏着大秦宝藏！
从目前的情况来看，大秦宝藏，绝不只是传闻！
一想到传闻中的大秦宝藏，或许可能会弄到手，即便是以冥夜无天的心性，也不免一阵激动和期待，“事关传说中的大秦宝藏，你居然不想着独自一人进入这里寻找宝物，反而拉上了我。”
牧帆笑了笑，“进入这里之后，能否顺利得到大秦宝藏，尚且未知，多一个帮手，就多一分成功的几率，不是吗？何况，无天兄帮了我大忙，我理应也送你一份机缘回礼！”
冥夜无天道：“我还是更喜欢你的第一个理由，多一个人，就多一分找到大秦宝藏的几率！”
牧帆望了一眼后方的光罩之门，“这个光罩之门，似乎是这片小世界唯一的出入口，而且没有我手中的这个玉玺的话，似乎任何人都无法进出，所以外面的那些人，应该都会被抵挡在外面，因此，接下来我们有充足的时间，在这个小世界内寻找大秦宝藏。”
冥夜无天双手环胸，“坦白说，我觉得你我二人联手，应该就没什么是办不成的。”
content_en:
The door of the mask, in the inner space.
After successfully crossing the light barrier gate, Mu Fan and Ming Ye Wutian walked out of the Great Qin Jade Seal.
Mu Fan and Ming Ye Wutian were both looking around vigilantly, taking stock of their surroundings.
The surrounding environment has completely changed compared to what it was in the Black Domain Plain.
In the Black Domain Plain, black mist shrouded the entire world, and the surface was extremely desolate. There was almost no life, spiritual consciousness, etc., all were greatly restricted. Anyone who entered it seemed to be blindfolded.
But here it is different. There are all kinds of flowers, plants and trees, full of vitality, as if you have come to a primitive forest, and your spiritual consciousness is not blocked or restricted.
Ming Ye Wutian's spiritual consciousness was released, and there was nothing strange. However, he found that he could not detect the edge at all, which meant that this place was quite vast. He suddenly became confused, "Where is this place? It looks very vast. I didn't expect that there is such a place inside the Black Domain Plain..."
Of course, Mu Fan didn't know where this place was, so he immediately sent a message and asked, "Sword Spirit, what do you think this place is?"
The sword spirit sent a message: "Who knows where this place is, but it is rumored that the treasure of Great Qin is hidden in the tomb of the First Emperor of Qin. Since the jade seal guided you here, maybe there is the tomb of the First Emperor of Qin here!"
Hearing this, Mu Fan lowered his head and looked at the jade seal in his hand. At this time, the jade seal was still guiding and shaking.
Ming Ye Wutian saw this and said, "Brother Mu Fan, we have all arrived here together. Is it time to tell me where this place is?"
Mu Fan thought for a moment and then said, "You must have heard about the Great Qin Dynasty in the Middle Ages and the Great Qin's treasures, right?"
Ming Ye Wutian's eyes suddenly froze, "I heard that the Great Qin Treasure is just a rumor, so naturally I have heard of it."
Mu Fan looked at the jade seal in his hand and explained: "There is a world in the Emperor God Realm called the King of Qin Realm. There is a Qin family in the King of Qin Realm. I heard that this Qin family is inextricably linked to the Great Qin Dynasty in the medieval period. As a result, the Qin family has been watched by countless people, and people from countless forces are trying to pry open the secrets of the Qin family."
"Finally, the battle broke out, and the Qin family was wiped out. Only the son of the head of the Qin family managed to escape with a piece of jade seal, so we began to speculate that this jade seal must be very unusual, and maybe it is related to the Great Qin treasure!"
Ming Ye Wutian looked at the jade seal in Mu Fan's hand and asked, "So this jade seal was obtained from the son of the head of the Qin family?"
"Exactly!"
Mu Fan nodded, "Previously, when I was in the Xuanyuan Heavenly Territory, a strange phenomenon suddenly appeared in the sky over the Black Territory Plain. From this moment on, the Great Qin Jade Seal seemed to be guided, shaking non-stop, pointing in a direction. From that time on, I came to the conclusion that the strange phenomenon in the Black Territory Plain may be related to the Great Qin Treasure."
Ming Ye Wutian said: "It turns out that there is this thing guiding you. No wonder you clearly had a clear goal when you were in the Black Domain Plain, without any delay, as if you were familiar with this place."
Mu Fan smiled bitterly and said: "This is only my second time coming to the Black Territory Plain. How can I be familiar with this place? It can be said that I don't understand it at all. It's just that I had this jade seal to guide me along the way, so I didn't delay."
Ming Ye Wutian crossed his arms and said, "It's no wonder that I couldn't enter here just now. With this jade seal, it will become so smooth."
If you look at it this way, there may really be a Great Qin treasure buried here!
Judging from the current situation, the Great Qin Treasure is by no means just a rumor!
When I think of the rumored Great Qin Treasure, I might be able to get it, even with Ming Ye Wutian's temperament, I can't help but feel excited and expectant, "It's about the legendary Great Qin Treasure, you don't want to enter this place alone."I was looking for treasures here, but instead I was attracted to him. "
Mu Fan smiled and said, "After entering here, it is still unknown whether we can successfully obtain the Great Qin Treasures. One more helper will increase the chance of success, right? Besides, Brother Wutian has helped me a lot, so I should also give you a gift of opportunity in return! "
Ming Ye Wutian said: "The first reason why I still like you more is that with one more person, the chance of finding Da Qin's treasure increases! "
Mu Fan glanced at the light shield door behind him, "This light shield door seems to be the only entrance and exit in this small world, and without the jade seal in my hand, it seems that no one can enter or exit, so those outside should be blocked from the outside. Therefore, we have enough time to search for the treasures of Da Qin in this small world. "
Ming Ye Wutian crossed his arms over his chest, "Frankly speaking, I think there's nothing we can't do if we work together. "
